title: A fake job interview just cost Binance $6.3 billion
description:
Binance hack explained: how a fake job interview, a poisoned pyenv and an EIP-7702 delegation drained $6.3 billion.

Binance says $6.34B left its hot wallets on Oct 29, 2026, and the FBI attributes the theft to North Korea's "TraderTraitor". Here's how the five-month campaign worked, according to Binance's own report, why pausing withdrawals didn't stop it, and four rules to steal for your own machine.
